title: Stylized casing where the incoming surface differs by real letters, not just case
why_real: arXiv is often misheard and reformatted as the ordinary word 'archive'; because the difference is real letters and not just a capitalization choice, the notebook is allowed to fix it — unlike the case-only 'arxiv' surface it must leave alone.

expected.reason: The dictionary entry's forms list contains 'archive', a real letter difference from the canonical, so both retrievers rewrite it — this is the in-scope half of the W3 casing split.
